description:
Unit: U2
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u2-consolidate-shared-support-and-helper-namespaces

Outcome
The repository has one compiled test-support root, one helper namespace, owner-specific ordinary fixtures, and a separate isolated-consumer root without compatibility modules.

Requirements and decisions
R3, R4, R8, R10-R13, R15, R17; KTD2, KTD3, KTD6, KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/jido/support/**; test/support/**; test/fixtures/**; test/consumers/**; mix.exs; .dialyzer_ignore.exs; test/test_helper.exs; and every active caller of moved or renamed support modules.

Implementation direction
Move test/jido/support into flattened owner paths below test/support/jido_<namespace> and remove the second compile path. Move ordinary fixtures under owner-specific support. Move inline_consumer to test/consumers/inline_consumer. Rename shared helpers and fixtures to Jido.Test.* and update callers atomically. Merge duplicate tracers and repeated helper infrastructure. Remove old test-module roots instead of forwarding them. Record every deletion.

Acceptance
The test environment compiles with lib and test/support as its only compile roots. Ordinary fixtures have an owner. The isolated consumer is not compiled as package support. Representative tests load final helpers. Dynamic modules, Mimic, ExCoveralls, and Dialyzer references use final names.

Verification
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix test --seed 0 --warnings-as-errors
mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors
mix test.property --warnings-as-errors
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
test/support is the only compiled support root, isolated consumers are separate, all active callers use final names, and U3 can start.
